  "working_thesis": "Hannah Arendt's phenomenological distinction between indoors and outdoors, grounded in her reflections on the earth and human artifice, can be used to analyze contemporary artificial adaptations to a warming planet (carapace, prosthesis, and enclosure) and highlights the narrowing angle of human receptivity to reality, while also revealing the limits of her framework in the face of planetary-scale socio-environmental inequalities.",
